newsitem.title: UK: BP reports 19 pct first-quarter profit rise.
newsitem.headline: BP reports 19 pct first-quarter profit rise.

text.p: British Petroleum Co Plc on Tuesday reported a 19 percent rise in first quarter profits and said it was ahead of schedule to meet its medium term targets.
Net earnings before exceptional items rose to 755 million pounds ($1.2 billion) from 633 million a year ago and were sharply higher than analysts' expectations.
BP said the impact of the cost savings from its European downstream merger with Mobil Corp will start to be "significant" later this year.
The oil giant added that the recent weakening of crude oil prices may lead to some further improvement in downstream margins.
But oil prices were still higher than a year ago, making them the main motor behind the first-quarter profit rise, BP said.
In the chemicals sector, margins are benefitting from lower feedstock prices in the short-term, but BP warned this may be offset by any further weakening of the mark.
Shares in BP gained 26 pence to 729-1/2 pence in late morning trade.
